info.long_name: Provisional maternal death count (12-month rolling total)
info.short_description: Provisional count of maternal deaths in the 12 months ending in the reference month.
info.long_description: Provisional count of maternal deaths, defined as the death of a woman while pregnant or within 42 days of termination of pregnancy from any cause related to or aggravated by the pregnancy or its management (ICD-10 codes A34, O00-O95, O98-O99). Reported as a 12-month backward rolling total. National level, overall and by age and race/Hispanic origin. Counts of 1-9 are suppressed by NCHS to protect confidentiality and imputed as 5; see vssr_suppressed_flag. Data are provisional and subject to revision as death certificates are processed.

info.long_name: Live births (12-month rolling total, denominator for maternal mortality rate)
info.short_description: Number of live births in the 12 months ending in the reference month, used as the denominator for the maternal mortality rate.
info.long_description: Provisional count of live births in the 12-month backward rolling period ending in the reference month, from the National Vital Statistics System. Serves as the denominator for vssr_maternal_mortality_rate. National level, overall and by age and race/Hispanic origin of the mother. Data are provisional and subject to revision.
info.statement: In {location}, there were {value} live births in the 12 months ending {time}.
info.restrictions: Public domain. CDC/NCHS data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

info.short_description: Provisional maternal deaths per 100,000 live births in the 12 months ending in the reference month.
info.long_description: Provisional maternal mortality rate, calculated as maternal deaths per 100,000 live births over the 12-month backward rolling period ending in the reference month. National level, overall and by age and race/Hispanic origin of the mother. Rates based on death counts under 20 are considered unreliable by NCHS and are not reported; see vssr_rate_unreliable_flag. Evaluation of trends should compare estimates from the same month in different years rather than adjacent months, since 12-month periods overlap. Data are provisional and subject to revision as more death certificates and birth records are received and processed.
info.statement: In {location}, the provisional maternal mortality rate was {value} per 100,000 live births in the 12 months ending {time}.
info.restrictions: Public domain. CDC/NCHS data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

info.long_name: Flag indicating the maternal death count was suppressed and imputed
info.short_description: 1 if the maternal death count was suppressed (1-9 deaths) and imputed as 5, 0 otherwise.
info.long_description: NCHS suppresses maternal death counts between 1 and 9 in accordance with confidentiality standards. When suppressed, vssr_maternal_deaths is imputed as 5 (the midpoint of the suppressed range) and this flag is set to 1. When suppressed, vssr_maternal_mortality_rate is also unreported.
info.statement: In {location}, the maternal death count in the 12 months ending {time} was {value_label}.
info.restrictions: Public domain. CDC/NCHS data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

info.long_name: Flag indicating the maternal mortality rate is unreliable or unreported
info.short_description: 1 if the maternal mortality rate is based on a death count under 20 and considered unreliable by NCHS (rate not reported), 0 otherwise.
info.long_description: NCHS considers maternal mortality rates based on fewer than 20 deaths unreliable, and does not report a rate in these cases (vssr_maternal_mortality_rate is missing). This flag identifies those cases, including cases where the underlying death count is also suppressed.
info.statement: In {location}, the maternal mortality rate in the 12 months ending {time} was {value_label}.
info.restrictions: Public domain. CDC/NCHS data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

nchs_vsrr_maternal.name: NCHS VSRR Provisional Maternal Death Counts and Rates
nchs_vsrr_maternal.description: National-level provisional maternal mortality rates based on a current flow of mortality and natality data in the National Vital Statistics System (NVSS). A maternal death is the death of a woman while pregnant or within 42 days of termination of pregnancy, from any cause related to or aggravated by the pregnancy or its management (ICD-10 codes A34, O00-O95, O98-O99). Rates are reported as 12-month backward rolling periods, overall and by age and race/Hispanic origin. Death counts of 1-9 are suppressed per NCHS confidentiality standards; rates based on fewer than 20 deaths are considered unreliable and not reported. Updated quarterly by NCHS; previously released estimates are revised as additional records are received.
nchs_vsrr_maternal.restrictions: Public domain. CDC/NCHS data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
